sources.snippet: Overview segformer-b0-finetuned-ade-512-512 is a lightweight semantic segmentation model maintained by nvidia that performs pixel-level scene understanding on images. The model consists of a hierarchical Transformer encoder paired with a lightweight all-MLP decoder head, trained first on ImageNet-1k and then fine-tuned on the ADE20K dataset at 512×512 resolution.
